extracted.intended_audience: students and researchers at universities in the United States and Canada (doctoral students, postdocs, undergraduate and graduate students interested in research in Germany)
extracted.subtask_description: Information about DAAD research grant offerings for students and researchers in the U.S. and Canada, including eligibility, program types (doctoral/postdoc, cotutelle, German Studies), nomination requirements, and typical project durations for research in Germany.

rubrics_metrics.name: General eligibility — US/Canada university affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: DAAD offers a variety of research grants for students and researchers at universities in the United States and Canada.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are expected to be students or researchers affiliated with universities in the United States or Canada. (No further eligibility details given on this page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Grants — target applicants and project duration
rubrics_metrics.description: DAAD research grants offers doctoral students and postdocs the opportunity to pursue short- or long-term research projects in Germany.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program targets doctoral students and postdoctoral researchers and supports both short- and long-term research projects in Germany; specific duration limits and application requirements are not detailed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cotutelle Doctoral Programs — bi-national doctoral funding
rubrics_metrics.description: The Cotutelle Doctoral Programs in Germany research grant offers funding for students to pursue bi-national doctoral degree programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports cotutelle (bi-national) doctoral degree arrangements; page indicates funding is available for students participating in such programs, but provides no further procedural details here.

rubrics_metrics.name: German Studies Research Grant — eligibility, nomination, and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: This specialized DAAD program offers German Studies Research Grants to highly-qualified undergraduate and graduate students who are nominated by the professor supervising their research project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirement: nomination by the supervising professor. Intended for highly-qualified undergraduates and graduates in German Studies. Allowed use: short-term research in Germany (one to two months).
